user.title: Setup T-Skylt Departure Board
user.description:
You can choose between directly using the IP address or the hostname.

**Hostname is recommended** if you use a repeater, since in the case of an IP address change, the hostname will be newly resolved automatically.

The default hostname is usually `esp32-s3-zero.local`.

**App on the board:** leave it on automatic unless detection picks the wrong one. The stock Departures app is "Legacy". Departures Plus must be running on the board while you add it.

error.plus_not_running: Departures Plus is not running on this board. Start the app on the board, or choose automatic detection.
